name: Frutiger Aero
places: software interface design broadly (Windows, early iOS, airport signage)
garments: not a fashion look — a UI and graphic design aesthetic (named for the typeface Frutiger, widely used in airport and tech signage of the era)
reacts_against: flat, minimal 2010s design (iOS 7 onward) retroactively made Frutiger Aero's glossy, dimensional, nature-plus-technology look feel like a lost, more optimistic era.
revivals: a 2020s nostalgia-driven online revival, grouped with Y2K and frutiger-aero-specific Discord/Tumblr communities

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Skeuomorphism, glossy textures, "Humanism", use of nature, bokeh, bubbles, Frutiger fonts, glass, auroras
